subtitle: Tasks, planning and focus
description:
Turn thoughts into tasks, plan your day, and stay focused in one calm workspace. Pomodoist combines practical task management with a built-in Pomodoro timer so planning and focused work stay connected. PLAN YOUR WORK
 
• Capture tasks quickly with text or voice 
• Organize projects, labels, priorities, and due dates 
• See Today, Upcoming, Inbox, Timeline, Kanban, and Priority Matrix 
• Search instantly across your workspace FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS 
• Start Pomodoro sessions from any task 
• Use full or minimal focus modes 
• Track completed intervals and focus time 
• Review productivity reports and weekly trends WORK ACROSS YOUR DEVICES 
• Use Pomodoist on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch 
• Sign in optionally to sync tasks between devices 
• Connect Google Calendar to plan Pomodoist-created events
• Keep using the app locally without an account Pomodoist Pro is available through monthly, annual, or one-time lifetime purchases.

 Payment and subscription management are handled by Apple. Privacy Policy: https://pomodoist.com/privacy/ Support: pomodoist@placeq.com

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Meet Pomo, your new focus companion. Plan tasks, build your rhythm, and celebrate progress. On Mac, your animated 3D buddy works and takes breaks alongside you.
macPromotionalText: Meet Pomo, a little companion for everything you want to get done.
